name: these-things-matter
description: These Things Matter — block theme (ttm-theme) and companion plugin (ttm-core) for eric.mann.blog

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run check:theme-json && npm run check:block-json && npm run check:budget
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js plugins/ttm-core/src themes/ttm-theme/assets/js scripts tests/e2e --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.test:integration: npm run env:start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/ttm-tests php ../ttm-vendor/bin/phpunit -c integration/phpunit.xml.dist
scripts.env:seed: wp-env run cli wp ttm seed
